profiles.P-HE: Designs and ships accessible, GenAI-supported learning tools on the frontline of a UK university. MA Education Leadership. WCAG 2.2 AA, Equality Act 2010, PSBAR 2018, UK GDPR. Bilingual English / Mandarin.
profiles.P-OPS: Turns manual processes into zero-error self-serve tools: 30 minutes to 9 seconds per record, two days to 30 seconds per check, admin email down 60 to 70 per cent. No-code and low-code (Power Automate, Make) with AI-assisted builds. MA Education Leadership.

projects.PRJ-REC: Student Records Automation · Power Automate + SharePoint — per-record workflow from about 30 minutes to 9 seconds, zero errors, no per-run cost; reusable by non-technical colleagues each term.
projects.PRJ-SORA: SORA (SEN) Exam Support Tool · on-device web tool — cross-references exam reasonable-adjustment lists entirely on-device: 2-day manual process to 2 hours (Excel-logic iteration) to 30 seconds. Related lecturer-notification workflow consolidated from 3 days to 1 across 155 emails per term (2 errors to 0).
projects.PRJ-BOOK: Self-Service Wellbeing Booking System · Microsoft Bookings + dashboards — replaced email-based appointment handling; cut related admin email 60 to 70 per cent. Dashboards gave the service demand data by topic and presenting issue; that evidence supported an approved staffing case.
projects.PRJ-DOC: Document Accessibility Audit — audited four student-facing documents against WCAG 2.2 AA using PAC: 15,705 structural errors at baseline; the first rebuilt document went from 2,068 errors to 4. Extended the SCULPT framework into a nine-point checklist.
projects.PRJ-UX: Student Services UX Review — turned repeated front-desk queries into a structured review; identified 12 systemic failure points across the VLE, registration, certification and finance processes. After presenting to IT and Library Resources, the VLE login path was redesigned and related queries fell.
projects.PRJ-GOV: Wrote a three-tier governance framework covering personal data, third-party copyright and account hierarchy, with five written working rules; adopted into the project plan as an institutional precedent.
projects.PRJ-MIRROR: Gentle Mirror · browser-based · privacy-first · on-device — facial expression detection (deliberately not emotion inference), re-architected around ICO guidance and EU AI Act Article 5(1)(f).
projects.PRJ-PARTNER: Coordinated 25 external partner organisations: in-depth meetings with 4 and one site visit; materials now used for campus signposting.
